title: Opening and identifying Dolly Douroux Adams
summary: Allen opens the 1962 interview at her home; she gives her name and that she is a niece of Professor Manetta.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: I'll make a note that we're interviewing Mrs. Adams and the date is April the 18th, 1962 and we're over at her home on 1560 North Johnson. Do you mind giving your full name?
My full name is Dolly Marie Adams.
And what was your name before you were married? Dolly DeRux. DeRux. So you were a daughter of one of Professor Mineta's sisters.
